final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON p.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS overall_avg_remaining_gb FROM grouped) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, g.avg_remaining_gb / o.overall_avg_remaining_gb AS remaining_ratio FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_remaining_gb IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
